title: Takikomi Gohan
description: Savory Japanese rice bowl dish with multiple ingredients cooked together in a single pot. Perfect for lunch or dinner.
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Heat sesame oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add jeweled vegetables and cook until tender.
Add soaked rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add gohan seasoning blend and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes.
Turn off heat and let rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in lemon juice and zest.
Garnish with additional jeweled vegetables and lemon wedges if desired
